name: 🥜 PB & Banana Toast
what: Hot toast with peanut butter, banana coins and a little honey.

core.name: Bread
core.out: English muffin, bagel or a tortilla

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Spread peanut butter on while it's hot.
Banana coins on top, honey and cinnamon.

key: Hot toast melts the peanut butter. A few flakes of salt on top.
done: The peanut butter looks melty and shiny.
plan_b: No bread? Apple or banana slices with peanut butter to dip.
